stories.title: Kawhi Leonard Case: The Full Penalty Scope Is Now Known

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: The NBA's Kawhi Leonard investigation is still pending — but the penalty menu is out. Worst-case under the CBA: contract voided, 40-game ban, $7.5M fine + draft picks. The Clippers are bracing for something significant. Toronto still can't plan. #HoopHeroes #Raptors

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: The Kawhi Leonard investigation involves a convicted fraudster (14-year federal sentence) at its center. The Clippers say they were victims. The NBA doesn't care — a ruling is coming, and it may come hard. #HoopHeroes #Clippers
